failures.evidence:
Red test `a reply under a document's decision keeps the lists of the typed blocks it holds` in packages/dispatch/e2e/text-typed-blocks.e2e.ts (commit 49082939). At the head: `cd packages/dispatch && bun run e2e -- e2e/text-typed-blocks.e2e.ts --project chromium --project iphone` -> 2 failed (chromium, iphone): `getByTestId('thread-').getByText('step one', { exact: true })` Expected: visible, Received: hidden (resolved to
  • step one
    • ). At 6d878d04 (base + the implementer's red test) the same new test PASSES in both projects, so this is a regression this change introduces. Cause, probed in the browser at the head: inside the document decision `[data-dispatch-ask-block=storage]` (data-dispatch-ask-options="rows"), computed display of the reply's lists was step-one-list=none, malformed-inner-ask-list=none, plain-list=block; removing data-dispatch-ask-options from the outer document block made all three `block`. The fold rule packages/dispatch/web/src/styles.css:418-421 `:is(.dispatch-doc, .dispatch-markdown) .proof-typed-block-ask[data-dispatch-ask-options="rows"] [data-proof-block-content] > ul { display: none }` uses a descendant combinator, and this change gives every typed block in a body a `[data-proof-block-content]` hole (the bare section at base had none), so the outer decision's fold now hides a callout's bullet list and a malformed inner decision's only option list in every reply shown in that decision's thread (the same reach applies to anything the card renders through MarkdownBody, such as an answer note). The `:first-child`/`:last-child` margin rules at styles.css:366-378 have the same reach. A fix scopes the fold (and the margin rules) to the block's own content hole, e.g. `> [data-proof-block-content] > ul`, after checking the document node view's DOM keeps the hole a direct child.
